# 0.53 CDC bake-off re-run (correct gear table)

<!-- Generated by scripts/bench/cdc_bakeoff.py --markdown; do not edit by hand. -->

The 0.40 bake-off (`docs/bench/0.40-cdc-bakeoff.md`) built its FastCDC gear
table with a fresh `random.Random(40)` per entry, so all 256 entries were equal
and its `cdc-*` rows did not cut on content. Those rows are void. This re-run
uses the gear table that stored data already uses (`opentine/remote/_fastcdc.py`:
one `random.Random(49)` generator, 256 distinct 64-bit entries); the script
refuses to run unless the table hashes to the pinned digest below. A second
script bug is also fixed: the synthetic corpus listed only loose objects, and
`put_run` now writes packs, so run objects were silently missing; the corpus
now lists loose and packed objects (`iter_object_oids`).

**Stored-data chunking is unchanged.** The 0.49 chunker was already correct;
only the bench script was wrong. Chunk boundaries are a stored form (oids,
canonical bytes and wire formats do not depend on them), and no frozen format
or vector changes in 0.53.

**Times are indicative.** Sizes and ratios are deterministic for the pinned
inputs. CPU and latency columns depend on the machine; the number for the
pinned runner (ubuntu-24.04, single-threaded) is produced in CI by the
`CDC bake-off (pinned runner)` job in `.github/workflows/bench.yml`, which
uploads `cdc.json` and `0.53-cdc.md` as artifacts. The table below is the
reference run that generated this file.
